title: The River Bend
description: Follow the shape of the river from a straight bank, around its bend, over eroded cliffs and along the wet inner bank to a viewpoint. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

signs.text:
The straight riverbank
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

Around the sweeping bend

The eroded outer bank

The wet inner bank

rooms.name: The straight riverbank
rooms.lesson: Build your rhythm along the bank. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: Around the sweeping bend
rooms.lesson: The route doubles around the river’s stone shoulders. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The eroded outer bank
rooms.lesson: Climb the exposed outer face. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The wet inner bank
rooms.lesson: Descend to the sheltered wet bank. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

rooms.name: The river viewpoint
rooms.lesson: Rise once more to see the full bend. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
